# Maintainer Notes

This directory holds maintainer-only planning material, content drafts, and internal strategy notes that do not belong in the public docs or repo landing surfaces.

## Structure

- `strategy/`: positioning notes, launch material, and internal growth audits.
- `content-drafts/`: draft blog posts and experiments that are not part of the live public website.

The public product/docs surface lives in:

- `README.md`
- `website/`
- `examples/`
- `docs/good-first-issues.md`
